# Parse the file list and reorganize
import re

# Get the list of entries (files and directories)
entries = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=fs_token, directory_path='~/documents/work/meetings_data/')

# Separate files and directories
files = [e for e in entries if not e.endswith('/')]
dirs = [e for e in entries if e.endswith('/')]

# For each file, parse date and file_name
for file_path in files:
    # Extract filename from path
    filename = file_path.split('/')[-1]
    # Split on "__"
    parts = filename.split('__')
    if len(parts) != 2:
        print(f"Skipping unexpected file: {filename}")
        continue
    date_str, rest = parts
    # rest is like "slides.ppt" or "video_recording.mp4"
    # Split on last dot to get file_name and extension
    if '.' in rest:
        file_name, ext = rest.rsplit('.', 1)
    else:
        file_name = rest
        ext = ''
    # New directory name: file_name
    new_dir = f"~/documents/work/meetings_data/{file_name}"
    # New file name: date_str + "." + ext
    new_filename = f"{date_str}.{ext}" if ext else date_str
    new_file_path = f"{new_dir}/{new_filename}"
    print(f"Moving {file_path} -> {new_file_path}")
    # Create directory if not exists
    apis.file_system.create_directory(access_token=fs_token, directory_path=new_dir, recursive=True)
    # Move file
    apis.file_system.move_file(access_token=fs_token, source_file_path=file_path, destination_file_path=new_file_path, overwrite=True)

print("All files moved.")
